column2: Topic: signs you're still growing (age, recent growth spurt, growing shoe size, parents' heights; soft wording). Hook: "Think you've stopped growing? Check these signs." Surface: brown kraft paper table. Cut style: vintage newspaper collage cutouts with halftone print and torn edges. Voice: ash.

Topic: you are about 1 cm taller in the morning because spinal discs compress during the day and recover during sleep. Hook: "Why are you taller in the morning?" Surface: blue blueprint drafting paper with white grid lines. Cut style: white technical line drawings on blueprint paper, engineering diagram look. Voice: cedar.

Topic: sleeping position and posture: back or side with a neutral spine, thin pillow, no curled-up neck. Hook: "Does your sleeping position steal your height?" Surface: dark navy felt. Cut style: soft felt craft cutouts with stitched edges and glow-in-the-dark star stickers. Voice: marin.

Topic: text neck: looking down at the phone rounds the shoulders and makes you look shorter; lift the phone to eye level, chin tucks. Hook: "Is your phone making you shorter?" Surface: grey self-healing cutting mat with grid. Cut style: flat app-icon style cutouts with rounded corners and bright UI colors. Voice: verse.

Topic: growth plates: most people keep growing into their late teens, it varies a lot person to person; sleep, food and activity help you reach your natural height while you still grow. Hook: "Do growth plates really close at 18?" Surface: bright yellow paper. Cut style: pop-art comic book cutouts with bold black outlines and halftone dots. Voice: echo.

Topic: your spine slightly compresses every day from gravity and sitting; hanging and stretching decompress it. Hook: "Your spine shrinks a little every single day." Surface: cream aged paper. Cut style: vintage anatomy textbook engravings, sepia ink. Voice: sage.

Topic: how to measure your height right: morning, barefoot, back to the wall, heels together, book flat on the head. Hook: "You're probably measuring your height wrong." Surface: cork board. Cut style: polaroid photo cutouts held with colorful push pins. Voice: coral.

Topic: one stretch before bed (child's pose or a doorway chest stretch) to relax the spine and posture before sleep. Hook: "One stretch before bed. That's it." Surface: pastel pink paper. Cut style: Memphis design cutouts, bold geometric shapes, squiggles and dots in bright colors. Voice: shimmer.

Topic: look taller in 10 seconds: stand tall, shoulders back and down, chin level, weight even on both feet. Hook: "Want to look taller in 10 seconds?" Surface: clean white table. Cut style: pixel-art stickers, retro 8-bit video game look. Voice: alloy.

Topic: what to eat for growing bones: protein, calcium and vitamin D (milk, eggs, fish, greens), plus sunlight. Hook: "What should you eat to reach your full height?" Surface: handmade cotton watercolor paper. Cut style: soft watercolor painted cutouts with loose brush strokes. Voice: ballad.
